about.title: Gina Digital Solutions Waɗanda ke Ci gaba da Kasuwancin
about.description:
Oklut Technologies kamfani ne na mafita na fasaha wanda aka mayar da hankali kan taimakawa kasuwancin su canza ra'ayoyi zuwa gogewar dijital mai ma'ana. Mun haɗu da fasaha, kerawa, da fahimtar kasuwanci don sadar da mafita waɗanda aka tsara a kusa da bukatun ainihin duniya.

section1.title: 1. Bayanan da Muke Tattara
body: Muna tattara bayanan da kuka bayar kai tsaye (kamar sunanku da adireshin imel lokacin da kuka ƙaddamar da fom ɗin tuntuɓar ko ƙirƙira asusu) da bayanan da aka tattara ta atomatik ta hanyar kukis da makamantansu, kamar shafukan da aka ziyarta, nau'in na'ura da kusan wurin.

section2.title: 2. Yadda Muke Amfani da Kukis
body: Ana kunna kukis masu mahimmanci koyaushe saboda gidan yanar gizon ba zai iya aiki daidai ba tare da su ba. Suna adana zaman da yanayin tantancewa kuma suna tuna abubuwan da kuka zaɓi kuki.

Kukis na nazari suna taimaka mana fahimtar yadda baƙi ke amfani da rukunin don mu inganta shi. Ana amfani da kukis ɗin tallace-tallace don nuna maka tayi da kamfen masu dacewa. Ana kunna waɗannan rukunan tare da izinin ku kawai kuma ana iya canza su a kowane lokaci daga kwamitin zaɓin kuki.

section3.title: 3. Tushen Shari'a (GDPR)
body: Muna aiwatar da bayanan sirri akan tushe na doka masu zuwa: izininka (don kukis masu mahimmanci da tallace-tallace), aikin kwangila (don ayyukan da kuke buƙata), wajibcin doka, da halaltattun abubuwan da haƙƙinku ba su ƙetare su ba. Kuna iya janye izini a kowane lokaci ba tare da shafar haƙƙin sarrafawa da aka aiwatar kafin janyewa ba.

section4.title: 4. Haqqoqinku
body: Dangane da wurin da kuke, kuna iya samun damar shiga, gyara, gogewa, ko ƙuntata sarrafa bayanan ku, don hana sarrafa bayanai, da ɗaukar bayanai. Hakanan kuna iya shigar da ƙara zuwa hukumar sa ido ta gida.

section5.title: 5. Riƙe bayanai & Tsaro
body: Muna riƙe bayanan sirri kawai muddin ya cancanta don dalilan da aka bayyana a cikin wannan manufar. Muna amfani da matakan fasaha da ƙungiyoyi masu dacewa don kare bayananku daga samun izini mara izini, canji, bayyanawa ko lalata.

section6.title: 6. Sabis na ɓangare na uku
body: Ana iya saita wasu kukis ta wasu masu ba da izini (kamar nazari ko dandamalin talla) waɗanda ke taimaka mana sarrafa gidan yanar gizon. Waɗannan masu samarwa suna aiwatar da bayanai a ƙarƙashin manufofinsu na sirri kuma kawai lokacin da kuka yarda da nau'in da ya dace.

ai-robotics-solutions.title: AI & Robotics Solutions
ai-robotics-solutions.tagline: Fasahar Fasaha. Ayyuka na atomatik. Kasuwancin Wayo.
overview: Sirrin Artificial da Robotics suna canza yadda ƙungiyoyi ke aiki, yanke shawara, da ba da ƙima. Hanyoyinmu na AI & Robotics suna taimaka wa kasuwancin su wuce aikin sarrafa kansa na gargajiya ta hanyar haɗa basirar wucin gadi, koyan inji, hangen nesa na kwamfuta, sarrafa kansa na fasaha, da injiniyoyi don magance ƙalubalen kasuwanci mai amfani.

Muna tsara mafita mai hankali a kusa da sakamakon kasuwanci mai aunawa. Ko abin da ake buƙata shine sarrafa maimaituwar aiki, nazarin ɗimbin bayanai, gano alamu, goyan bayan yanke shawara, ko gabatar da mutummutumi a cikin yanayin aiki, tsarinmu yana mai da hankali kan dogaro, haɓakawa, tsaro, da ƙimar kasuwanci na dogon lokaci.
transformation: Ƙungiyoyin zamani suna samar da adadi mai yawa na bayanai kuma suna yin dubbai na maimaita ayyukan kowace rana. AI da robotics na iya canza waɗannan ayyukan zuwa hankali, ayyukan aiki na atomatik waɗanda ke haɓaka yawan aiki yayin ba da damar ma'aikata su mai da hankali kan babban nauyi mai ƙima.

Maganganun mu na iya taimaka wa ƙungiyoyi su sarrafa ayyukan maimaitawa, rage sa hannun hannu, haɓaka daidaito, bincika bayanai masu rikitarwa, goyan bayan yanke shawara mai sauri, haɓaka amfani da albarkatu, haɓaka ƙwarewar abokin ciniki, da gina tsarin fasaha mai ƙima.

overview: Kasuwancin sarrafa kansa yana bawa ƙungiyoyi damar maye gurbin ayyukan hannu mai maimaitawa tare da ingantaccen tsarin aiki na dijital. Waɗannan matakai suna cinye lokacin ma'aikata masu mahimmanci kuma suna iya gabatar da jinkiri, rashin daidaituwa, da kurakurai.
Hanyar mu ta atomatik tana mai da hankali kan fahimtar cikakken tsari, cire matakan da ba dole ba, haɗa tsarin, da sarrafa ayyukan da ke ba da ƙimar aiki mafi girma.

solutionEngineering.pillar1Desc: Ingantattun dabaru na aikace-aikace da injunan jihohi masu sarrafa kansu da aka saita su musamman a kusa da ka'idojin aikin ku na ciki.
solutionEngineering.pillar2Desc: Amintattu, ingantattun gadoji na bayanai masu haɗa abubuwan da suka mallaka, rukunin ERP, ƙofofin biyan kuɗi, da sabis na girgije.
solutionEngineering.pillar3Desc: Sabbin gyare-gyaren gine-gine masu zurfi waɗanda ke canza software na kamfani ba tare da karya hanyoyin haɓakawa ko yarjejeniyar tallafin mai siyarwa ba.
solutionEngineering.pillar4Desc: Ƙimar tambaya mai ban tsoro, kawar da ƙyallen ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya, da rarraba CDN gefe don lodin shafi na biyu na biyu.
solutionEngineering.ctaTitle: Shirye don Keɓance Dandalin Kasuwancin ku?

digitalTransformation.description: Cikakken gyare-gyare na hanyoyin kasuwanci, gine-ginen fasaha, da tsarin aiki don fitar da haɓakar ƙungiyoyi, ingantaccen aiki, da ci gaban dijital mai dorewa.
digitalTransformation.row1Title: Daga hangen nesa zuwa Taswirar Hanya
digitalTransformation.row1P1: Muna haɗin gwiwa tare da shugabannin masana'antu don ayyana dabarun dijital, shari'o'in kasuwanci, da taswirar hanya tare da nasara cikin sauri da yanke hukuncin kisa.
digitalTransformation.row1P2: Shirye-shiryen da aka ba da fifiko, samfuran TCO, da KPI suna tabbatar da kowane ƙoƙarin sabunta fasahar yana da alaƙa kai tsaye zuwa kudaden shiga, inganci, da sakamakon gamsuwar abokin ciniki.

digitalTransformation.row2P2: Muna sabunta aikace-aikacen aikace-aikacen, bayanan bayanai, da matakan haɗin kai yayin da muke kiyaye daidaito da yanayin tsaro.
digitalTransformation.row3P1: Ɗauki AWS, Azure, da GCP, gina bututun bayanai na zamani, da shigar da jami'an koyo na inji don fitar da yanke shawara masu cin gashin kansu.
digitalTransformation.row3P2: Daga ainihin-lokaci yawo na taron zuwa ga haɗe-haɗe dashboards, canji ya zama abin aunawa kuma mai dorewa.
digitalTransformation.row4P1: Sake tsara tafiye-tafiyen abokin ciniki a cikin gidan yanar gizo mai amsawa, iOS, Android, da hanyoyin sadarwar sabis na kai tare da keɓaɓɓun musaya.
digitalTransformation.row4P2: Injiniyan dandamali, na'urorin sadarwa, da madaukai na amsawa na atomatik suna sa sabbin abubuwa na dijital su ci gaba.
digitalTransformation.pillarsSub: Sakamako-mayar da hankali levers da tabbatar da dorewa jagoranci dijital.
digitalTransformation.pillar1Desc: Tsare-tsare na sauye-sauye tare da ƙirar harka kasuwanci, tsarin gine-gine, da bin diddigin haɗari.
digitalTransformation.pillar2Desc: AWS/Azure/GCP ginshiƙan girgije da yawa, bututu masu sarrafa kansu, da damar nazarin bayanan kasuwanci.
digitalTransformation.pillar3Desc: Kayan aiki na fasaha na fasaha, ma'aikatan AI masu fahimi, da na'urar hangen nesa don haɓaka ayyukan yau da kullun.
digitalTransformation.pillar4Desc: Babban-canzawa na omnichannel na dijital da keɓaɓɓun mu'amala da aka gina don iyakar riƙe mai amfani.
digitalTransformation.ctaSub: Abokin Hulɗa tare da Oklut Technologies don ɓata lokaci, sauyi na dijital da ba shi da haɗari wanda ke da alaƙa da sakamakon kasuwanci mai aunawa.

endToEndSolutions.row1P1: Taro na haɗin gwiwa, taswirar yanki na kasuwanci, da ƙayyadaddun gine-ginen girgije da aka tsara don kawar da haɗari kafin a rubuta layin lamba.
endToEndSolutions.row1P2: Muna ayyana ƙirar bayanai, tsarin tsaro, da matakan scalability waɗanda suka kafa nasara na dogon lokaci.
endToEndSolutions.row2Title: Cikakkun Cikakkun Tari & Gwaji Mai sarrafa kansa
endToEndSolutions.row2P1: Microservices na yau da kullun, nau'ikan APIs masu aminci, da gaban gaba mai amsa hade da naúrar sarrafa kansa, haɗin kai, da binciken tsaro.
endToEndSolutions.row2P2: Cigaban bututun haɗin kai tare da GitHub Actions, Terraform, da matakan tsaro na atomatik.
endToEndSolutions.row3Title: Aiwatar da Gajimare & 24/7 Gudanar da Kulawa
endToEndSolutions.row3P1: Ƙaddamar da girgije mai yawa akan AWS/Azure/GCP tare da jujjuyawar atomatik, yanke-saukar lokaci-lokaci, da kuma lura da gaske.
endToEndSolutions.row3P2: Muna ba da goyon baya na SLA da ci gaba da sa ido kan na'urorin sadarwa don haɓaka samfuran ku ba tare da matsala ba.
endToEndSolutions.row4Title: Haɗin Kan Mulki & Taimakon Ci gaba
endToEndSolutions.row4P1: Aiwatar da ma'ana guda ɗaya a cikin dukkan tarin dijital ku - saurin gudu na gaskiya, tsara kasafin kuɗi mai tsinkaya, da ci gaba da ƙirƙira.
endToEndSolutions.row4P2: Filayen fasali na yau da kullun da sake zagayowar zamani suna sa kasuwancin ku gaba da gasar.
endToEndSolutions.pillarsSub: Kowane lokaci da aka ƙera shi tare da tsangwama na kasuwanci.
endToEndSolutions.pillar1Desc: Gano yanki, taswirorin gine-gine, da daidaitawar masu ruwa da tsaki don kawar da kasadar kisa.
endToEndSolutions.pillar2Desc: Ƙwararrun microservices na asali na girgije, haɗin API, da ci gaba da gwajin QA.
endToEndSolutions.pillar3Desc: Amincewa da aminci na rashin aminci, sakin kwantena, da tura girgije mai sarrafa kansa.
endToEndSolutions.pillar4Desc: 24/7 SLA saka idanu, na'urorin kiwon lafiya, da injiniyan juyin halitta mai gudana.
endToEndSolutions.ctaTitle: Kuna Bukatar Cikakken Abokin Zaman Rayuwa?
endToEndSolutions.ctaSub: Muna da cikakken tsarin rayuwa na fasaha don haka ƙungiyar ku za ta iya mai da hankali kan ainihin sakamakon kasuwanci.

migrationServices.description: Amintacce, ƙaura mai tsari na aikace-aikacen gado, ma'ajin bayanai, da ababen more rayuwa zuwa gine-ginen girgije na zamani, an haɗa su tare da ci gaba da zamani don haɓaka haɓakawa da inganci.
migrationServices.row1P1: Ƙaurawar nauyin aiki mara kyau a cikin AWS, Azure, da Google Cloud tare da ganowa ta atomatik, shirin igiyar ruwa, da katsewar kasuwanci.
migrationServices.row1P2: Muna daidaita rehosting, sake fasalin, da kuma sake fasalin don inganta jimillar farashin mallakar (TCO) da ƙarfin hali.
migrationServices.row2Title: Amintaccen ETL & Tabbatar da Bayanai Na atomatik
migrationServices.row2P1: Kwafiwar bayanai ta atomatik, fassarar tsari, da babban bututun ETL tare da tabbatar da amincin bayanan 100%.
migrationServices.row2P2: Kokarin yankewa na lokaci-lokaci ba tare da bata lokaci ba yana tabbatar da cikakken daidaiton bayanai da ci gaban kasuwanci.
migrationServices.row3P1: Sake sabunta abubuwan gado na gado zuwa ƙananan ƙananan sabis waɗanda aka tsara ta Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) tare da tsarin IaC mai sarrafa kansa.
migrationServices.row3P2: Bayanin aikin bayan hijira da haɓaka farashi yana tabbatar da ROI nan da nan.
migrationServices.row4P1: Littattafan runguma da aka gwada-yaƙi, suites masu jujjuyawar atomatik, da hanyoyin juyawa nan take don cikakken kwanciyar hankali.
migrationServices.row4P2: Na'urorin kiwon lafiya na bayan hijira da 24/7 hypercare suna ba da tabbacin kwanciyar hankali na samarwa.
migrationServices.pillarsSub: Matsalolin da ba su da haɗari waɗanda SLAs ke tallafawa.
migrationServices.pillar1Desc: Fitarwar Canary da daidaitawa biyu-rubutu bayanai don tabbatar da samun damar mai amfani mara yankewa.
migrationServices.pillar2Desc: Kwatancen Checksum, ƙididdigar ƙima, da daidaitawar ETL ta atomatik.
migrationServices.pillar3Desc: Ƙuntataccen ka'idojin dawo da bala'i da kuma horo na gwaji don ɗaukar haɗari a kowane lokaci.
migrationServices.pillar4Desc: Haƙƙin gajimare, manufofin sarrafa kai, da dashboards na gudanarwar farashi sun haɗa.
migrationServices.ctaTitle: Shirye don yin Hijira tare da cikakkiyar Amincewa?
migrationServices.ctaSub: Abokin Hulɗa tare da Fasahar Oklut don tsararru, gajimare mara haɗari da sabunta bayanai.

pilotPrototyping.description: Ci gaba da sauri da kuma tabbatar da hanyoyin fasahar fasaha don tantance yiwuwar fasaha, ƙimar kasuwanci, bukatun haɗin kai, aiki, da haɓakawa kafin aiwatar da cikakken aiki.
pilotPrototyping.row1P1: Juya ra'ayi zuwa ma'aunin ma'auni na kasuwanci yana buƙatar ingantaccen ingantaccen gaba. Sabis ɗinmu na PoC & Pilot yana kimanta yuwuwar fasaha, gwajin damuwa-gwajin haɗin kai mai mahimmanci, kuma yana tabbatar da ROI na kasuwanci kafin manyan alƙawuran babban jari.
pilotPrototyping.row1P2: Muna gina MVPs masu aminci da matukin jirgi mai yashi wanda ke tabbatar da yuwuwar fasaha, auna jinkirin tsarin, da kuma tattara ingancin masu ruwa da tsaki kai tsaye da wuri.
pilotPrototyping.row1Cap: Samfuran MVP mai sauri & Alamar Fasaha
pilotPrototyping.row2Title: MVPs masu hulɗa & Tabbatar da UX
pilotPrototyping.row2P1: Muna gina firam ɗin wayoyi masu ma'amala da juna, kwararar mai amfani da za a iya dannawa, da kuma tabbatar da ra'ayoyin aiki a cikin kwanaki, ba watanni ba. Gwada mu'amalar mai amfani ta gaske, daidaita tsarin UI/UX, da tattara ra'ayoyin da za a iya aiwatarwa daga masu ruwa da tsaki.
pilotPrototyping.row2P2: Ta hanyar rage madaukai ra'ayoyi yayin haɓakawa na farko, ƙungiyar ku ta rage girman sake yin aiki kuma ta kafa fayyace ƙayyadaddun fasaha kafin fara matakan ginin babban jari.
pilotPrototyping.row2Cap: Ci gaba da sauri & Samfuran UX masu dannawa
pilotPrototyping.row3P1: Buɗe ƙwanƙolin fasaha, iyakokin API, da ƙayyadaddun ayyukan aiki kafin cikakken ƙaddamar da babban jari. Ƙwararrun injiniyoyinmu na gwaji-gwajin haɗakarwa, bututun bayanai, da APIs na ɓangare na uku a cikin keɓaɓɓen mahallin akwatin yashi.
pilotPrototyping.row3P2: Wannan rage haɗarin haɗari yana tabbatar da babban tsarin samar da tsarin, bin tsaro, da kuma jadawalin ci gaban da ake iya faɗi yayin canza PoC ɗin ku zuwa samar da kasuwanci.
pilotPrototyping.row4Title: Ƙaddamar da matukin jirgi da aka yi niyya & Tabbatar da Harka kasuwanci
pilotPrototyping.row4P1: Sanya fitar da matukin jirgi da aka yi niyya zuwa yankin mai amfani ko kasuwar gwaji. Bi diddigin ma'aunin aiki, nazarin karɓo mai amfani, da martanin aiki don ƙididdige ƙimar kasuwanci da kafa shari'ar kasuwanci mai goyon bayan bayanai.
pilotPrototyping.row4P2: Tare da fahimtar matukin jirgi na gaske, masu tallafawa zartarwa suna samun fayyace ma'auni na ROI don tabbatar da faɗaɗa yawan turawa da saka hannun jari na canji na dijital.
pilotPrototyping.row4Cap: Gudanar da Ƙaddamarwa & Ayyukan Watsa Labarai
pilotPrototyping.pillarsSub: Ka'idodin jagora waɗanda ke juya rashin tabbas na fasaha zuwa nasarar kasuwancin da ake iya faɗi.
pilotPrototyping.pillar1Desc: Isar da samfura masu aiki da sauri don tabbatar da ƙima a farkon zagayowar rayuwa.
pilotPrototyping.pillar2Desc: Tabbatar da dacewar API, madaidaitan kayan aiki, da ƙuntatawa a cikin mahallin akwatin sandbox.
pilotPrototyping.pillar3Desc: Yi kwaikwayon nauyin samarwa don kafa iyakokin iya aiki da ƙayyade girman gine-ginen girgije.
pilotPrototyping.pillar4Desc: Ƙididdiga ROI na zahiri da ma'aunin ƙima don tallafawa yanke shawara na fitar da masana'antu.
pilotPrototyping.ctaTitle: Shirye don tabbatar da maganin dijital ku na gaba?
pilotPrototyping.ctaSub: Haɗa tare da ƙungiyar injiniyoyinmu don bincika buƙatun aikinku, gina samfuri, da gwada yuwuwar ba tare da haɗarin sifili ba.

sharedServices.pillar4Desc: Ci gaba da daidaita girman albarkatun albarkatu, sabunta lasisi, da rage farashin girgije mai sarrafa kansa.

aiRobotics.intro: Intelligence Artificial (AI) da Robotics suna canza yadda kasuwancin ke aiki ta hanyar haɗa yanke shawara mai hankali tare da ingantacciyar sarrafa kansa. AI yana ba injina damar yin nazarin bayanai, koyan tsari, da kuma yanke shawara mai wayo, yayin da injiniyoyin ke kawo waɗannan damar zuwa duniyar zahiri don aiwatar da ayyuka tare da sauri, daidaito, da daidaito.
aiRobotics.section1Text: Hanyoyinmu na AI da Robotics suna taimaka wa ƙungiyoyi su daidaita ayyuka, rage ƙoƙarce-ƙoƙarce na hannu, da haɓaka yawan aiki a cikin masana'antu daban-daban. Daga aiki da kai da kuma nazarce-nazarce zuwa robotics masu kaifin basira da tsarin fasaha, muna isar da sabbin fasahohi waɗanda ke haɓaka inganci, haɓaka haɓakawa, da tallafawa canjin dijital.
aiRobotics.section2Heading: Inda hankali ya hadu da aiki
aiRobotics.section2Text: Kowace hulɗa, yanke shawara, da motsi ana yin ta ta hanyar tsarin haɗin gwiwa guda ɗaya - juya bayanai zuwa sakamako a ainihin lokacin.

informationReporting.heroSubtitle: Tushen gaskiya guda ɗaya ga kowane sashe - an gina shi don juyar da ɗanyen bayanan aiki zuwa shawarwarin kasuwancin ku na iya aiwatar da su a yau.

informationReporting.section1Heading: Tsari ɗaya na tsakiya don kowane ma'auni mai mahimmanci
informationReporting.section1P1: Bayanai & Tsarin Ba da rahoto sune mahimman hanyoyin kasuwanci waɗanda ke ba ƙungiyoyi damar tattarawa, sarrafa, da canza bayanai zuwa fahimta mai ma'ana. Waɗannan tsare-tsaren suna haɗa bayanai daga sassa da yawa, suna tabbatar da ingantaccen, daidaito, da samun dama ga mahimman bayanan kasuwanci. Ta hanyar samar da dandamali mai mahimmanci don sarrafa bayanai, ƙungiyoyi za su iya inganta yanayin aiki, daidaita ayyukan aiki, da goyan bayan yanke shawara mai mahimmanci a duk matakan kasuwancin.
informationReporting.section1P2: Waɗannan tsarin suna amfani da rahoton kai tsaye, nazari, da dashboards don bin diddigin aiki, saka idanu ma'auni, da samar da rahotanni na ainihi. Ta hanyar rage ƙoƙarce-ƙoƙarce na hannu da haɓaka daidaiton bayanai, kasuwanci na iya yanke shawara da sauri da inganci.
informationReporting.section2Heading: Gina don ganuwa, yarda, da ma'auni
informationReporting.section2Text: Tare da ingantaccen gani, yarda, da haɗin gwiwa, Tsarin Bayanai & Ba da rahoto yana ba ƙungiyoyi damar haɓaka matakai, haɓaka haɓaka aiki, da haɓaka ci gaban kasuwanci mai dorewa a cikin yanayi mai fa'ida.

businessTransformation.sec1Heading: Kewayawa Complexity a cikin Kasuwancin Haɓaka
businessTransformation.sec1Subtext: Kamar yadda harkokin kasuwanci ke da ma'auni, babu makawa tsarin fasahar fasaha ya fadada. Abin da ya fara azaman mafita da aka mayar da hankali ga sassan daidaikun mutane na iya rikidewa zuwa gidan yanar gizo mai rikitarwa na tsarin saɓani.
businessTransformation.sec2Subtext: Lokacin da aikace-aikacen kasuwanci, ma'ajin bayanai, da tsarin aiki suka samo asali daban-daban, kwararar bayanai sun zama rarrabuwa. Fahimtar wannan rarrabuwa shine muhimmin mataki na farko.
businessTransformation.sec3Subtext: Kamfanoni suna matsawa zuwa ga abin da ke gudana, API-farko gine-gine inda bayanai ke gudana cikin dogaro a cikin manyan dandamali kuma su kai ga masu yanke shawara a ainihin lokacin.
businessTransformation.sec4Subtext: Lokacin da aikace-aikacen kasuwanci ke sadarwa ba tare da ɓata lokaci ba, bayanai sun daina zama samfurin rahoto kuma ya zama babban direba na ƙarfin aiki.
businessTransformation.sec5Subtext: Cikakken ra'ayi game da ginshiƙan wuraren fasaha waɗanda ke tsara tushen tushe na zamani, mai ƙima.
businessTransformation.sec6Subtext: Ɗaukaka tsarin gine-ginen aikace-aikace da haɗa rarrabuwar bayanai yana ba da ingantaccen ingantaccen aiki a cikin ƙungiyar.

businessTransformation.sec1P1: A cikin yanayin kasuwanci na yau da kullun, haɓaka yakan gabatar da tsararraki masu yawa na software. Kudi, sarkar samar da kayayyaki, sabis na abokin ciniki, da ayyukan filin sau da yawa suna aiki akan tarin software daban da aka samu ko aka gina a lokuta daban-daban. Tsawon shekaru na juyin halitta na aiki, waɗannan tsarin suna haɓaka tsarin bayanan nasu, sabunta ƙididdiga, da abubuwan haɗin kai.

Ta hanyar kafa API mai ƙarfi da Layer haɗin kai, tsarin yana hulɗa ta hanyar sarrafawa, amintattun wuraren ƙarewa yayin da suke kiyaye yancin kai na ƙungiyoyin kasuwanci ɗaya.
businessTransformation.sec3P2: Mahimman damar fasaha na wannan canjin gine-gine sun haɗa da:

businessTransformation.sec4P1: Haɗaɗɗen tushe na bayanai suna canza yadda jagoranci da ƙungiyoyin aiki ke hulɗa da bayanai. Maimakon dogaro da rahotannin baya-bayan nan da ke nuna abin da ya faru makonnin da suka gabata, ƙungiyoyi suna samun na'urar sadarwa ta wayar tarho kai tsaye a cikin sassan kasuwanci.
businessTransformation.sec4P2: Bayanan da aka haɗe da nazari suna goyan bayan sakamako mai dorewa na kasuwanci ta hanyar:

sec4List.text: Ci gaba da nuna gaskiya a cikin tallace-tallace, kaya, cikawa, da aikin kuɗi.
Tarin bayanai akan buƙatu wanda ke kawar da maimaita maƙunsar bayanai na hannu.
Ma'anoni guda ɗaya don ma'auni kamar gefe, ƙimar rayuwar abokin ciniki, da saurin jagora.
Gano tsarin tsinkaya wanda ke haifar da haɗari da dama kafin lokaci.
Amintaccen aikin zartarwa wanda ke goyan bayan ingantattun layin bayanai da bayyana gaskiya.

artificialIntelligence.sec1Eyebrow: SHIGA ZUWA GA HANKALI NA YAN KASA
artificialIntelligence.sec1Subtext: Hankali na wucin gadi yana canzawa daga ayyukan gefen gwaji zuwa ainihin aikace-aikacen aiki waɗanda kamfanoni ke dogaro da su kowace rana.
artificialIntelligence.sec2Subtext: Motsawa sama da rubutun tushen ƙa'idar gargajiya zuwa hanyoyin aiki na fahimi waɗanda ke fahimtar abubuwan da ba a tsara su ba, daidaitawa ga bambance-bambancen, da haɓaka hanyoyin haɓakawa.
artificialIntelligence.sec3Subtext: An kafa shi a cikin ilimin ƙungiya da tsaro na kasuwanci, mataimakan AI suna aiki a matsayin abokan haɗin gwiwa na musamman a cikin ayyukan kasuwancin yau da kullun.

artificialIntelligence.sec5Subtext: Hanyoyi masu amfani da ke jagorantar ƙungiyoyi suna amfani da hankali na wucin gadi a cikin mahimman ayyukan kasuwanci.
artificialIntelligence.sec6Subtext: Lokacin da aka aiwatar da hankali tare da bayanan kasuwancin da ake gudanarwa, AI yana buɗe fa'idodi masu mahimmanci.
artificialIntelligence.ctaHeading: Bincika damar AI don Kasuwancin ku
artificialIntelligence.ctaDescription: Gano yadda ƙwararrun ƙwararrun ƙwararrun ƙwararrun ƙwararrun ƙwararrun masana'antu da samfuran tsinkaya za su iya buɗe ingantaccen aiki a cikin ainihin tsarin ku.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P1: Tsawon shekaru, ana kula da bayanan sirri na kamfani azaman iyawar waje: samfurin da aka horar da shi a keɓe, nunin akwatin yashi, ko keɓantaccen chatbot da ake samun dama ta hanyar tashar daban. A yau, tsarin ya canza asali. Babban kamfani AI yana haɗa kai tsaye a cikin tsarin rikodin - ERPs, CRMs, dandamali na babban birnin mutane, da injunan samar da sarkar inda kasuwancin gaske ke faruwa.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P2: Lokacin da hankali ke aiki a cikin tsarin rikodin, yana gaji iyakokin tsaro da aka kafa na ƙungiyar, ƙirar bayanai, da dabarun kasuwanci. Ba wai kawai ya haifar da amsoshi ba; yana aiki akan oda kai tsaye, yana fassara buɗaɗɗen tikitin goyan baya, daidaita daftarin masu kaya, kuma yana taimaka wa ma'aikata cikin ainihin mu'amalar da suke kewayawa kowace rana.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P3: Wannan canji yana motsa software na kasuwanci daga ma'ajin bayanai masu wucewa waɗanda ke jiran maɓallan maɓalli na ɗan adam zuwa dandamali masu fa'ida waɗanda ke tsammanin buƙatu, sarrafa matakai, da kuma shimfidar shawarwarin kan lokaci.
artificialIntelligence.sec2P1: Traditional Robotic Process Automation (RPA) ya yi fice wajen tantancewa, maimaituwar goge fuska. Koyaya, ƙaƙƙarfan ƙa'idar tana saita karya duk lokacin da tsari ya canza, shimfidar daftarin aiki ba tsammani ya zo, ko keɓantawa ya faru. Haɓaka aiki da kai yana gadar wannan rarrabuwar ta hanyar haɗa tunanin fahimi tare da aiwatar da ma'amala:

sec2List.text: Kirkirar hadaddun ayyuka na sashen giciye, ayyukan da suka danganci gaggawa da hanyoyin ƙudiri na tarihi.
Shigar da PDFs marasa tsari, imel, bayyanar jigilar kaya, da kwangiloli, mai da su zuwa ma'amalar bayanai da aka tsara.
Aiwatar da ingantattun matakan aiki da yawa-kamar daidaita odar siyayya akan rasidu da bayanan banki.
Ci gaba da yin nazarin rajistan ayyukan don gano ƙulla-ƙullun lokacin sake zagayowar da ba da shawarar gyare-gyaren aikin da aka yi niyya.

modernErp.sec1P1: A cikin shimfidar wuraren kasuwancin da ke tafiya cikin sauri, tsarin Tsare-tsaren Albarkatun Kamfanoni na gargajiya yakan yi kokawa. An gina shi a cikin zamanin sarrafa tsari da keɓantattun sabar gida, ERPs na gado an ƙera su sosai, da wahalar haɓakawa, kuma ba su da zafi. Muhimman ayyukan kasuwanci sun yi aiki a cikin siloes masu kama da juna, suna dogaro da ƙarancin fitarwa na dare don aiki tare da ledoji tare da ɗakunan ajiya.
modernErp.sec1P2: Na zamani, ERP na asali na girgije yana sake fasalin wannan ƙarfin. Yana aiki azaman ƙashin bayan dijital na kamfani - tushe mai rai inda kuɗi, sayayya, sarkar samarwa, ƙira, da albarkatun ɗan adam ke mu'amala akan tsarin bayanan da aka raba.
modernErp.sec1P3: Ta hanyar kawo mahimman ayyuka a cikin yanayi guda ɗaya mai jituwa, ERP na zamani yana kawar da wuraren makafi masu aiki waɗanda ke rage saurin girma, yana bawa shugabanni damar jagorantar kasuwancin ta amfani da sigina na ainihin lokaci maimakon taƙaitaccen taƙaitaccen tarihin tarihi.
modernErp.sec3P1: Silos na aiki ba safai ba ne matsalolin mutane; matsalolin gine-gine ne. Lokacin da sabis na abokin ciniki, sayayya, da ƙungiyoyin sito ke aiki a aikace-aikacen da ba a haɗa su ba, kowane abin hannu yana buƙatar imel na hannu, maƙunsar bayanai, da kiran waya. Kurakurai suna ninkawa, ana ɗaukar daftari, kuma alƙawuran abokin ciniki suna raguwa.
modernErp.sec3P2: ERP na zamani yana magance wannan ta hanyar haɗaɗɗiyar zuriyar bayanai da ƙungiyar ƙaƙƙarfan tsari:

sec3List.text: Lokacin da aka ba da odar abokin ciniki, ƙididdiga tana adana ta atomatik, alamun jigilar kaya suna samarwa, kuma lissafin lissafin kuɗi suna ɗaukaka nan take.
Odar siyayya, rasidin kaya, da daftar dillalai suna daidaita ta atomatik tare da sulhu ta hanyoyi 3, suna nuna keɓancewa kawai don bita na ɗan adam.

sec3List.bold: Haɗin gwiwar aiki da tsadar aiki:
sec3List.text: Taswirar lokutan aiki, rabon biyan albashi, da taswirar kashe kuɗi kai tsaye zuwa cibiyoyin farashi a ainihin lokacin.

modernErp.sec4P1: Yin aiki da kamfani ba tare da ganuwa ɗaya ba kamar yawo cikin hazo mai yawa tare da jinkirin kayan aiki. ERP na zamani yana samar da telemetry na ainihi a kowane nau'in kasuwanci:

sec4List.text: Ra'ayoyin kai tsaye na babban riba, tafiyar da kuɗaɗen aiki, buɗaɗɗen lamuni, da yin odar bayanan baya ba tare da jiran rufewar ƙarshen zamani ba.

sec4List.bold: Ba da rahoton aikin kai sabis:
sec4List.text: Shugabannin sassan za su iya gina tambayoyin al'ada kuma su yi ƙasa daga taƙaitawar matakin kasuwanci zuwa abubuwan layin ma'amala guda ɗaya.
Kawar da lambobi masu cin karo da juna ta hanyar kafa bayanan mai sarrafa guda ɗaya don abokan ciniki, masu siyarwa, da kasidar samfur.
Faɗakarwa mai sarrafa kansa yana sanar da manajoji nan da nan lokacin da tafki ya faɗi ƙasa ƙasa, ƙididdiga ta yi ƙasa kaɗan, ko isar da kayayyaki.

cybersecurity.sec1Heading: Tsarin Tsarin Tsaro na Kasuwancin Haɗe
cybersecurity.sec1Subtext: Kamar yadda ƙungiyoyin zamani ke haɗa ƙarin aikace-aikace, yanayin girgije, ma'aikatan nesa, na'urorin hannu, da abokan haɗin gwiwa na ɓangare na uku, kewayen tsaro na gargajiya ya daina wanzuwa.
cybersecurity.sec2Heading: Kariyar Barazana Mai Layi da yawa
cybersecurity.sec2Subtext: Kare kai tsaye waɗanda ke kiyaye mahimman abubuwan more rayuwa, mahimman bayanan kamfanoni, da tsarin aiki.
cybersecurity.sec3Subtext: Identity shine tushen tsarin kula da tsaro na zamani. Kusan duk munanan tashe-tashen hankulan tsaro suna farawa ne da ɓangarori na takaddun shaida maimakon cin gajiyar software.
cybersecurity.sec4Subtext: Zero Trust ba samfur ko kayan aiki ɗaya ba ne. Dabarun gine-ginen da ke kan ka'ida madaidaiciya: amince da wani abu a ciki ko wajen cibiyar sadarwa ta tsohuwa.
cybersecurity.sec5Subtext: Kare nauyin aiki a cikin gajimare na jama'a, gine-ginen gine-gine, da mahallin kwantena da aka rarraba.
cybersecurity.sec6Subtext: Gaskiyar juriyar yanar gizo ta yarda cewa al'amura na iya faruwa. Shirye-shiryen yana mai da hankali kan ɗaukar hanzari, ƙarancin rugujewar kasuwanci, da tabbatar da murmurewa.
cybersecurity.sec7Subtext: Gina kamfani mai juriya ta yanar gizo yana kare ƙimar kungiya, matsayi na tsari, da kuma martabar kasuwa.
cybersecurity.ctaDescription: Bincika yadda ƙungiyoyi za su iya ƙarfafa tsaro, kare tsare-tsare masu mahimmanci da kuma shirya barazanar barazana a duk wuraren da ke da alaƙa.
cybersecurity.sec1P1: A zamanin gado na IT, tsaro yana aiki akan koyarwar katangar-da-moat: duk abin da ke cikin cibiyar sadarwar kamfani an ɗauka amintacce ne, yayin da duk abin da ke waje ana ɗaukarsa ba amintacce ba. Tacewar zaɓi na kamfani guda ɗaya ta kare sabar ciki, bayanan bayanai, da kwamfutocin tebur.
cybersecurity.sec1P2: Kamfanoni na yau sun zarce bangon jiki. Ayyukan aiki suna zaune a cikin mahalli da yawa (AWS, Azure, GCP), ma'aikata suna samun damar aikace-aikacen kasuwanci daga wurare daban-daban, kuma APIs suna ci gaba da musayar bayanan aiki masu mahimmanci tare da masu samar da kayan aiki na waje, cibiyoyin kuɗi, da masu siyar da SaaS.
cybersecurity.sec1P3: Duk da yake wannan haɓaka-haɗin kai yana haifar da haɓakar kasuwancin kasuwanci, yana faɗaɗa yanayin harin kasuwanci. Kowane wurin ƙarshen API, alamar shaida, na'urar hannu da aka haɗa, da haɗin kai SaaS suna wakiltar yuwuwar faɗuwa. Kariyar sana'a ta gaskiya tana buƙatar canzawa daga tushen tushen tsaro zuwa gabaɗaya, juriyar yanar gizo daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshen.

cloudModernization.sec1Subtext: Tsofaffi monoliths suna ƙuntata saurin ƙirƙira, haɓaka raunin aiki, da haɓaka farashin kula da ababen more rayuwa.
cloudModernization.sec2Subtext: Nasarar sabuntar girgije ta fara da tsantsar kima. Tsalle kai tsaye cikin ƙaura ba tare da duba abubuwan dogaro da aikace-aikacen ba shine babban dalilin jinkirta yankewa.
cloudModernization.sec3Subtext: Babu dabarar ƙaura mai-girma-daya. Manyan masana'antu sun dace da daidaitaccen tsarin zamani na kowane takamaiman aikin aiki bisa ƙimar kasuwanci, gaggawa, da bashi na fasaha.
cloudModernization.sec4Subtext: Tsararren taswirar hanya wanda ke canza gadon monoliths zuwa na roba, amintattu, da sabis na gajimare.
cloudModernization.sec5Subtext: Matsar da tsarin gada zuwa ga gine-ginen girgije na zamani yana ba da ƙarfin aiki na zahiri da tsinkayar farashi.
cloudModernization.ctaDescription: Bincika ingantacciyar hanya don tantancewa, zamani da motsa aikace-aikacen gado zuwa ga madaidaitan, amintattun gine-ginen girgije.
cloudModernization.sec1P1: Aikace-aikace masu mahimmancin manufa da aka gina shekaru goma da suka gabata har yanzu suna fitar da biliyoyin cikin kudaden shiga na kasuwanci, duk da haka ƙaƙƙarfan tsarin su na haifar da haɓaka haɗarin aiki.
cloudModernization.sec1P2: Kowane kamfani yana fuskantar tashin hankali tsakanin kwanciyar hankali da zamani. An kera tsarin gado don dorewa, kuma sun yi aiki da dogaro tsawon shekaru. Koyaya, yayin da buƙatun kasuwanci ke haɓaka, waɗannan gine-ginen tsofaffi sun haɗu da iyakoki na tsari:

sec1List.text: Monolithic codebases da aka gina akan ginshiƙan da aka yanke tare da raguwar wuraren wahawar gwaninta da ke akwai don kulawa.
Abubuwan da aka haɗa tare da juna inda canza fasalin fasalin guda ɗaya ke yin haɗari da karya tsarin aiki marasa alaƙa.
Iyakoki na sikeli na tsaye waɗanda ke buƙatar siyan kayan aikin mallakar kayan masarufi masu tsada don ɗaukar matakan zirga-zirgar lokaci.
Rashin iya yin mu'amala cikin sauƙi tare da aikace-aikacen wayar hannu na zamani, tashoshin abokin ciniki, ko APIs na abokin tarayya ba tare da rubutun batch ba.
Kewayoyin rayuwa na dakin uwar garken jiki, rashin lahani, da babban ƙarfin aiki / sanyaya kashe kudi.

cloudModernization.sec2P1: Tafiya ta ƙwaƙƙwaran zamani ta fara ne ta hanyar tabbatar da cikakken haske a cikin abubuwan da ake da su:

sec2List.text: Ƙididdigar duk kayan aiki masu aiki, ƙirar al'ada, rubutun baya, da fakiti na ɓangare na uku na tarihi.
Taswirar hadaddun lokaci mai rikitarwa, tebur na bayanai da aka raba, kiran tsarin fayil kai tsaye, da kwangilar sabis na waje.
Ƙimar tsarin bayanai, buƙatun amincin ma'amala, rarrabuwar kawuna, da ƙa'idodin ikon mallaka.
Nau'in CPU, ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya, amfani da ajiya, da kuma samar da hanyar sadarwa zuwa ƙayyadaddun girgije mai girman madaidaitan manufa.
Rarraba aikace-aikace zuwa matakai don tsara amintattun igiyoyin ƙaura tare da bayyanannun hanyoyin koma baya.

cloudModernization.sec4P1: Tsarin gine-ginen da aka nufa yana ƙaddamar da ainihin aikace-aikacen zuwa na yau da kullun, sabis ɗin kwantena wanda aka shirya akan dandamalin girgije na roba (kamar Kubernetes ko sarrafa lokacin runtime mara sabar).
cloudModernization.sec4P2: Ta hanyar kafa bututun tura bututun CI/CD mai sarrafa kansa, masu yanke shuɗi-kore mai sarrafa kansa, da kayan more rayuwa azaman lambar, ƙaddamarwa tana canzawa daga abubuwan da suka faru na ƙarshen mako zuwa abubuwan yau da kullun marasa lahani.
cloudModernization.sec4P3: Elastic compute automatically scales up during demand surges and scales down during lulls, eliminating idle resource costs while guaranteeing sub-second response times for global users.
cloudModernization.keyPerspectiveLead: Kwarewa ta nuna cewa ayyukan zamani suna samun nasara idan aka kafa su akan cikakken shiri, bayyanannen jerin igiyoyin ruwa, da tsauraran gwaji:
